name: El Niño forecast: the ENSO model zoo
description: Niño 3.4 forecasts by baselines, the recharge and delayed oscillators, LIM, gradient boosting and hybrids under the study's protocol (tuned on the development period, scored on the untouched 2012- test period): skill against climatology and persistence with Holm-adjusted Diebold-Mariano tests, anomaly correlation per lead; plus the solver checks. The observations (OISST, WOD, ERA5) are downloaded once into the data cache (examples/enso_forecasting/run_study.py).
